decision.observation: The forked driftwood plank now runs from lower-center to upper-right against the rock outcrop, whose dark cave-like opening is visible with small green shrubs beside it; palm fronds top the frame at right. Stamina full green with hatched tail.
decision.hypothesis: Walking straight up the slope barely advances. Moving right along the contour toward the plank and outcrop should gain ground, as diagonal traverses did earlier.
decision.memory: Contour traverse (W+D) has worked better than straight uphill on this sand.
